new = '''By default, enum values are serialized to JSON as integers. The signedness of the stored integer matches the enum's
underlying type: unsigned underlying types produce unsigned JSON numbers, and signed underlying types produce signed

re-ordered after data has been serialized to JSON, the later de-serialized JSON data may be undefined or a different
enum value than was originally intended.'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))

s = p.read_text()
old = 'By default, enum values are serialized to JSON as integers. In some cases this could result in undesired behavior.'
new = 'By default, enum values are serialized to JSON as integers, with signedness matching the underlying type. In some cases this could result in undesired behavior.'
assert s.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY
